items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: Jim got an autographed copy of that book to me... Because I guess Jim played him a couple of things that I’m on.

ctx.x: Maria Schneider said something about that. She said, “you have to live a life if you want to” — you can’t just play music you have to —

You have to live it. That’s right. And that’s true for any music. Look at the rock & rollers. They live it. Why don’t the jazzers? Well they did. For a long time. I think back, I was heavily influenced by the 52nd Street Eddie Condon’s and Jimmy Ryan’s and that whole scene there in the 50s. Hugely influenced. I just bought all the records I could. My dad had a lot in his collection too. He wasn’t so much of a big band guy, I started the big band collection. Dad had Ray Charles records and Oscar Peterson Trio and…
